content:
The root of the lineage. Motion as something that can be charted: frames are functions of time, beats sit on a grid, instruments (bearing ring, depth gauge, beat grid) annotate the movement, and one Sanzo Wada combination keys each piece. Built on the CETI design system.

First version. Tokens = CETI design system + seven Wada combinations; type = Fraunces 300 italic / DM Sans / Space Mono; motion = the five CETI eases, no bounce.
